title: Opening
description: What opens a seal (setup-contract-13): the declaration the seal was made from and the 32-byte salt its actor minted, in lowercase hex. It goes only to whoever runs the window, as a file named for its actor's reference, and a party may hand over its own to open its seal in a dispute. That the salted digest of the declaration's canonical bytes is the seal, and that the declaration's actor is the seal entry's, are rules of the text a schema cannot state.
